creneauImport.title: Add créneaux to the calendar
creneauImport.intro: Paste one or more créneaux as you write them: the date, then each segment with its hours, “Prière1: …” and the verses. Paste a whole day, a week or a month: each date starts a new créneau.
creneauImport.placeholder:
THURSDAY 5 NOVEMBER 2026

Opening prayer 12:00-12:03

12:10-12:15
Prière1: Father, thank you for your divine power…
John 10:10 “The thief comes only to steal…”
creneauImport.replaceWarning: These segments will replace the program's. The segment in progress ends normally; prayer hours already counted are kept.
creneauImport.noSegments: No times found. Each segment needs its times, for example “12:10-12:15”.
creneauImport.dateLabel: Date for créneaux without a date
creneauImport.calendarNote: Each créneau takes its place at its hour. Anything already planned at the same hours is replaced. Between two written créneaux the AI carries on with the last one: the prayer never stops.
creneauImport.repeatHint: The pasted days repeat to fill {{days}} days, from the first one.
creneauImport.savedPeriod: {{days}} day(s) scheduled, {{segments}} segments. You can change or replace them anytime: paste a day again to replace it.
